entry.title: 9/11 Responders Passed Effects of Trauma to Their Children

link.title: 9/11 Responders Passed Effects of Trauma to Their Children

entry.content: Although it’s been 25 years since the World Trade Center collapsed after terrorists flew commercial airplanes into each of the center’s two towers, the trauma experienced by many first responders and recovery workers is still being felt by their children.
